The Meeting of Board of Directors and other committees have been conducted in a manner as specified in SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, except the composition and quorum of Board and Committees, attributable to the vacant position of Independent Directors during the quarter. The matter was taken up with the administrative Ministry i.e. Ministry of Power for filling up the post of Independent Directors (Including Woman Independent Director).
